purpose: Independent SEO/AEO/GEO closed loop: target queries -> grounded observation -> competitor/reference comparison -> GSC truth -> diagnosis -> bounded non-agent existing-page repair -> validation -> same-query retest -> before/after evidence. It is separate from AI-agent intake and never changes publishing cadence.

grounded_search.why_not_gemini: Google GenAI grounded search is hard-blocked on this project's key. A plain generateContent call returns 200; the identical call carrying tools:[{google_search:{}}] returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Reproduced across three models and persistent, so it is a capability block rather than a transient quota. The lane pointed at it anyway, recorded calls_attempted: 0 with 'No grounded-search credential was available', and that untested state was read downstream as if it were a finding.

retired_provider.kept_for: provenance of observations recorded before the repoint

truth_boundaries: Grounded search observation is not literal Google SERP rank.
Google Search Console is the authority for own-site Google impressions, clicks, CTR, and average position.
Provider unavailable or degraded is never green.
A repair is not successful until later same-query provider evidence proves improvement.
AI-agent intake/acceptance/absorb/apply is a separate protected subsystem and is never called by this lane.
